caption: Puerta del Puente, Córdoba
composition: Night · Puerta del Puente from Plaza del Triunfo toward the Roman Bridge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Puerta del Puente in Córdoba at night, with two warriors and the Crown of Spain shield in the circular pediment above the Philip II inscription, and the Roman Bridge beyond.
description: The unfinished circular pediment carries two warriors displaying the Crown of Spain shield. Beneath it is the Philip II dedicatory inscription. The Roman Bridge shows through the passage from Plaza del Triunfo.
viewpoint: Plaza del Triunfo, looking toward the bridge. Exact camera point remains provisional.
